Package frc.lib.NinjasLib.localization

Interface VisionStrengthCalculator

Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface VisionStrengthCalculator
A pluggable per-axis trust ("Kalman strength") calculator for vision measurements, injected into RobotPose and passed on to NinjasPoseTracker.setVisionMeasurementStrength(edu.wpi.first.math.Matrix<edu.wpi.first.math.numbers.N3, edu.wpi.first.math.numbers.N1>) for measurements that pass the configured VisionFiltersCalculator. This is what determines how hard a given vision measurement pulls the pose estimate towards it versus trusting odometry.

    static VisionStrengthCalculator
    ninjasFunction(double factor, double epsilon, double rotationFactor, DoubleSupplier odometryDrift)
    Builds a strength calculator whose trust in a vision measurement decreases with the square of the distance to the closest visible tag, and increases as accumulated odometry drift grows (drift is floored by epsilon before being raised to a power that grows slowly below 1 and quickly above 1, so trust in vision ramps up faster once odometry has drifted noticeably).
    static VisionStrengthCalculator
    ninjasFunction(DoubleSupplier odometryDrift)
    Same as ninjasFunction(double, double, double, DoubleSupplier), using the library's default tuning (factor=1.5, epsilon=0.05, rotationFactor=0.5).

    • ninjasFunction

      static VisionStrengthCalculator ninjasFunction(double factor, double epsilon, double rotationFactor, DoubleSupplier odometryDrift)
      Builds a strength calculator whose trust in a vision measurement decreases with the square of the distance to the closest visible tag, and increases as accumulated odometry drift grows (drift is floored by epsilon before being raised to a power that grows slowly below 1 and quickly above 1, so trust in vision ramps up faster once odometry has drifted noticeably).
      Parameters:
      factor - Larger values reduce the effect of distance, yielding higher overall trust.
      epsilon - A small floor added to odometryDrift to avoid degenerate behavior near zero drift.
      rotationFactor - Multiplier applied to the x/y trust to get the rotation (theta) trust.
      odometryDrift - Supplies a current estimate of accumulated odometry drift/uncertainty.
      Returns:
      A strength calculator combining target distance and odometry drift.

    • ninjasFunction

      static VisionStrengthCalculator ninjasFunction(DoubleSupplier odometryDrift)
      Same as ninjasFunction(double, double, double, DoubleSupplier), using the library's default tuning (factor=1.5, epsilon=0.05, rotationFactor=0.5).
      Parameters:
      odometryDrift - Supplies a current estimate of accumulated odometry drift/uncertainty.
      Returns:
      A strength calculator combining target distance and odometry drift, with default tuning.
